# `chapter`

<!-- Generated by `vidgen gallery`; edit the sample in AGENTS.md (or video.yaml), not this file. -->

**Use it for:** a new section.

An accent rule draws in, the number (and icon) and the title slide in from either side of it, then the subtitle rises. In a wide frame with a number or icon they stand left of a vertical rule and the title right of it; otherwise everything is stacked and centred.

## YAML

From the author guide (`vidgen guide scenes`):

```yaml
- id: part1
  type: chapter
  params: {number: 1, title: "The problem", icon: triangle-alert}
  duration: 2.5
```

## Params

| param | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `str` | required | The chapter's name (wrapped to fit). |
| `number` | `int \| str \| None` |  | Chapter number: an integer (shown with number_format, e.g. 02) or text such as 'II' or 'Part 2'. |
| `number_format` | `str` | `'{:02d}'` | Python format for an integer number: '{:02d}' gives 02, '{}' gives 2, 'Part {}' gives Part 2. |
| `subtitle` | `str` |  | Line under the title. |
| `icon` | `icon \| None` |  | Optional icon (above the number, or in its place). |
| `rule` | `bool` | `True` | Draw the accent rule between number and title. |
| `number_color` | `color` | `'primary'` | Number color. |
| `rule_color` | `color` | `'primary'` | Rule color. |
| `icon_color` | `color` | `'primary'` | Icon color. |
| `title_color` | `color` | `'text'` | Title color. |
| `subtitle_color` | `color` | `'dim'` | Subtitle color. |
| `number_size` | `size \| None` |  | Number size; default 2.4x the theme's title size (1.6x for text such as 'Part 2'). |
| `title_size` | `size` | `'title'` | Title text size. |
| `subtitle_size` | `size` | `'subtitle'` | Subtitle text size. |

## Targets

`icon`, `number`, `title`, `subtitle`

## Beats

Any number.
